simulate.title: Simulate NC program
simulate.chooseOrPaste: Choose or paste an NC program first.
simulate.intro: This mode follows the final controller code against the setup stock and project tools. Machine travel, fixtures, PLC macros, and tool holders are outside this first layer.
simulate.placeholder: Paste G-code here, or open an NC file above.

operation.adaptiveExperimentalNote: Experimental roughing. Inspect CAM and NC simulation before use. Small corners and undercuts may remain; no holder or fixture checks.
operation.adaptiveGeometryNote1: Uses all setup target bodies and the full setup stock. Current CAD geometry is captured on every regeneration. Edit Stock & WCS to change targets.
operation.adaptiveGeometryNote2: Upper-envelope protection supports changing 3D cross-sections, but cannot reach undercuts. Previous-operation and previous-setup rest stock are not used.
operation.adaptiveHeightsNote: Top and Bottom define the depth range. A lower Top does not assume stock above it is gone: entry clearance, flute reach and the first stepdown are checked against known incoming stock.
operation.adaptivePassesNote: Envelope resolution adds a conservative safety margin. It is not a finished-part tolerance. Smaller values require more memory and planning time.
operation.adaptiveToolHint: Center-cutting flat and bull-nose end mills, including radiused or chamfered corners. Check feeds for your tool and material.
operation.additionalWidthZeroNote: Additional width 0 follows the modeled bevel.
operation.assignedToolIncompatible: The assigned tool is incompatible. Choose a supported tool before generating this path.
operation.assignedToolIncompatibleEndMill: The assigned tool is incompatible. Choose a supported end mill before generating this path.
operation.automaticLeadsHelp: Automatic leads use Cutting feedrate. Choose Manual in Linking to set separate lead feedrates and geometry.
operation.chainsHelpManual: Click individual connected edges to build an open or closed chain. Click again to remove an edge. No gaps, branches, or automatic closing segments are added.
operation.chainsHelpMulti: Click each perimeter or hole rim to add another chain. Selected chains stay highlighted. Click an existing chain to edit it; Option-click picks an individual edge.
operation.chainsHelpSingle: Hover an edge to preview its loop; click once to select the complete perimeter. Inner rims and outer boundaries stay separate. Option-click picks a single edge.
operation.chainsNeedAttention: One or more chains need attention. Select the marked chain to inspect it; all chains must resolve before saving.
operation.chamferChainNote: Material side is for chain {n}. Width allowance, tip offset and milling direction apply to all chains. Return to Geometry to edit another chain.
operation.chamferCornerTransitions: The bevel has separate corner transitions. This pass follows the upper rim and may leave material on those corners; inspect the simulated result before posting.
operation.chamferLeadsHelp: Fits a tangent entry and exit to each chain, reporting any reduction. Uses Cutting feedrate and the configured Heights. Choose Manual to specify radii, sweep angles, straight distances, vertical rounding and separate lead feedrates.
operation.chamferManualChainHelp: This source saves one typed chain only. Switch back to Model edges or Sketch curves to use your picked chains.
operation.chamferModeledHelp: Select the upper or lower rim of a modeled 45° bevel. Width, top height and material side are measured from its adjacent faces. Use a 90° chamfer mill.
operation.chamferSharpHelp: Select the sharp edge and enter the required width on Passes. Top height can follow the selected edge plane.
operation.chamferTipNote: Tip offset positions the cutting flank below the bevel root. Width + tip offset must fit within the cutter radius. Tangent entry/exit moves are clearance-checked.
operation.compensationCheckNote: The check uses generated move length, not just the lead distance field. In-control assumes the full project tool radius, not wear-only compensation.

operation.entryExitPolicyNote: Entry and exit follow this operation's generated policy. Independent vertical lead radii, overlap, and transition-style controls are not implemented.

operation.leadsHelp: Tangent leads are checked against the selected profile using the project's cutter diameter, including controller-compensated entry and exit. This does not certify neighboring bodies, fixtures, or a different machine offset. Inside profiles start on a straight edge. Regenerate after changing geometry.
operation.linkingHelp: XY rapid transfers lift to clearance first. One-way facing returns at clearance; pocket clearing uses axial entry with a center-cutting tool. Reaming and boring feed out. High-feed conversion and general keep-down controls are not implemented.

machine.newFromStarter: New machine from a starter profile
machine.privateSpindleStop: Private spindle-stop call: {program}, then M5. Its controller-resident behavior cannot be verified by CAM or NC simulation.
machine.savedNotice: Saved in Settings → CAM → Custom posts. Project snapshots stay independent.
machine.starterHelp: Starter profiles are not commissioned machine kits. Review tool changes, offsets and post settings before NC output.
machine.noMachineHelp: Program and simulate now. A matching machine/controller and post are required before NC output.
machine.currentExecutionHelp: Current execution: fixed 3-axis milling. Rotary, 4/5-axis, turning and mill-turn are reserved for later support.
machine.guidanceSiemens: Native Siemens: G1 engagement/cancellation with XY travel, NORM approach and explicit G451 intersection corners (outside turns up to 90°). Rounded leads are optional. Verify the machine-data corner-switch limit; Z-only startup and G450 transitions are not supported.
machine.guidanceIso: Fixed-axis ISO milling: G1 XY compensation entry/exit at least the project tool radius, explicit G43 H from the tool number and machine-coordinate G53 retracts. No probing, rotary or builder macros.
machine.guidanceOkuma: OSP milling: G15 H1–H6 work offsets, G56 H tool length and G16 H0 machine-coordinate retracts. Compensation uses G1 XY entry/exit at least the tool radius. NC replay is not supported for OSP.
machine.guidanceHeidenhain: Fixed-axis TNC: TOOL CALL, preset rows 1–6 (cycle 247), L/CC/C and M91 retracts. Compensation entry/exit at least the tool radius. No rotary or builder macros; conversational NC replay is not supported.
machine.guidanceLinuxCnc: LinuxCNC: G1 XY entry at least the project tool radius; cancellation exit longer than the diameter.
machine.guidanceGrbl: GRBL requires in-computer cutter compensation; G41/G42 output is blocked.

post.noSetup: Create a CAM setup before posting NC code.
post.title: Post NC — {name}
post.compensationNote1: In-control checks assume the full project tool radius is entered at the control, not a wear-only offset.
post.compensationNote2: No travel, holder, fixture, PLC or whole-machine collision verification is performed.
post.toolCallsHelp: Tool calls come directly from the project tool library. Edit numbers/names there; no separate mapping or per-tool confirmation is needed. Duplicate or unrepresentable calls are rejected.
post.machineRetractHelp: Machine coordinates, not workpiece clearance. Used before tool changes, changed work offsets and program end. Confirm the safe Z for this machine; zero is not assumed. Builder macros and rotary motion are not enabled.
post.workOffsetsIntro: This setup posts {count} {parts} under {offsets}. Change the count by editing the setup (double-click it in the browser).
post.privateSpindleStopAfter: , then M5. The machine's subprogram is not simulated; verify it on the controller. This setting comes from the selected private profile.
post.atcGuidanceTail: Physical style is informational; positioning and preload are separate explicit settings. The standard profile emits no custom spindle slowdown macro.
post.toolChangeExampleHeader: LATER TOOL-CHANGE EXAMPLE · VERIFY, DO NOT COPY BLINDLY
post.storageHelp: Import private profiles and reference sources in Settings. Select a saved native profile in Setup → Machine & Controller. Imported scripts are not executed.
post.analyzerHelp: This analyzer reads legacy JavaScript .nbpost references, not native JSON profiles. Inspection is local and non-executing.
post.analysisOnly: Analysis only—script execution remains disabled until the compatibility sandbox is complete.
post.reviewConfirm: I reviewed the target, machine-specific post settings and offset assumptions. This is not machine safety certification.
post.errorSelectMachine: Select a machine/controller in Setup before posting NC.
post.errorReviewMachine: Review the machine settings and offset assumptions before preparing NC.
post.atcGuidanceDoubleArm: Double-arm machines normally have a calibrated tool-change height and spindle orientation.
post.atcGuidanceUmbrella: Umbrella machines also use a calibrated tool-change height; the shuttle layout does not prove that an XY move is required.
post.atcGuidanceCarousel: Carousel, chain, or wheel storage does not by itself define the spindle-side change station.
post.atcGuidanceCustom: Use the machine-builder manual or a proven M6 program to define this custom changer.
post.atcPositioningSupaZ: This profile emits G0 SUPA Z{height} D0 before later changes.
post.atcPositioningController: This profile assumes the M6/PLC cycle owns all station motion.
post.atcPositioningEnterXy: Enter both verified machine X and Y station coordinates before posting.
post.atcPositioningStation: This profile retracts Z first, then moves to machine X{x} Y{y}.
post.atcPreloadCarouselWarning: Warning: next-tool T preload is enabled even though it may index this carousel/chain/wheel magazine; verify it on this exact machine.
post.atcPreloadEnabled: Next-tool T preload is enabled; verify that an early T call safely stages the magazine on this exact machine.
post.atcPreloadDisabled: Next-tool T preload is disabled, so every executable T call belongs to the M6 immediately following it.
post.customPostsHelp: Private to this OS user, outside the app and project. Independent of the central tool library folder, so changing libraries or installing a new build does not move your posts.
post.desktopOnly: Private post storage is available in the desktop app.
post.nativeProfilesHelp: Native .nbpost profiles select a built-in renderer with your machine settings. Imported scripts are kept byte-for-byte, including rights notices, for reference only; they are not executable post plug-ins. Existing files are never overwritten on import.

linking.retractionHint: Unproven links retract. Shortest links use G1 to avoid diagonal rapid ambiguity.
linking.allowRapidRetractHint: Disable to withdraw at lead-out feed instead of G0.
linking.safeDistanceHint: Clearance for entry/retract and non-cutting links. Cannot authorize an uncut shortcut.
linking.keepToolDownHint: Only links proved clear of stock may stay down.
linking.stayDownLevelHint: Higher settings try more checked links; clearance and engagement limits never change.
linking.extendBeforeRetractHint: Carry the cutter beyond incoming stock before lifting.
linking.chamferNote: Every chain retracts to Clearance Height before transferring to the next. Set transfer heights on the Heights tab.
linking.transitionHint: Stay-down transitions need Keep tool down and a clear path; otherwise retract.
linking.chamferValuesHelp: These values apply to every selected chain. Manual dimensions are never automatically reduced; a chain that cannot fit blocks generation.
linking.leadHelp: Radii describe the physical tool center. Leads are checked before posting; neighboring fixtures and holders still need separate verification.
linking.horizontalRadiusHint: Physical tool-center arc radius. Zero gives a straight lead.
linking.sweepHint: 0° removes the horizontal arc; 90° is a quarter circle.
linking.linearChamferHint: Straight tool-center travel before the entry arc or after the exit arc. Zero omits it.
linking.linearContourHint: A positive straight move is required to engage or cancel controller compensation.
linking.perpendicularHint: Approach toward the arc radially instead of tangentially. Software compensation only.
linking.verticalRadiusHint: Round the plunge/withdrawal into the horizontal move. Zero disables vertical rounding.
linking.rampTypeHint: Predrill requires earlier hole-removal evidence. Plunge explicitly permits full-width axial cutting at Ramp Feed with a center-cutting tool.
linking.positionsHelp: Entry/exit points are preferences, not plunge permissions. A predrill position must be backed by an earlier enabled hole deep and wide enough for the tool. Coordinates are saved in this setup’s WCS.

tool.effectiveDiameterHelp: Engaged shallower than the corner radius, the contact point rides the radius: De = D − 2R + 2√(2R·ap − ap²). This is what moves surface speed vs rpm on high-feed tooling. Leave ap empty for full-radius engagement (De = D).

tool.profileCopyHelp: The picked profile is copied into operations that choose this tool. Editing the library later never rewrites existing operations.
tool.stepDefaultsHelp: New operations that pick this tool seed their stepdown / stepover from these values until the operator types one. A step-over past the diameter is rejected.
